lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in 5-6 roughly parallel horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the fifth gill slit. Centroids exhibit uniform horizontal spacing approximately 1.5 to 2.0 times the average blob diameter in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows at near-orthogonal angles, forming a coordinate-like grid where circular luminance maxima serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each is defined by a sharp vertical gradient consisting of a high-intensity luminance peak on the dorsal edge and a corresponding shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-18 high-luminance blobs are bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette. The distribution is non-uniform, with a higher spatial frequency of smaller spots located towards the posterior margin and the fin base.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple Echeneidae (remoras) are visible as distinct dark, elongated silhouettes clustered primarily around the ventral and posterior margins of the pectoral fin and the mid-ventral line.
